description.full:
Afan A Blast is a mountain bike hire, retail, and servicing business located at Ynyscorrwg Park in Glyncorrwg, part of the Afan Forest Park in South Wales. Situated at the Glyncorrwg Mountain Bike Centre — one of the major trail hubs in the Afan Valley — the operation provides direct access to world-class mountain biking terrain including the Blade, Skyline, White's Level, and W2 trails, along with the Rheilffordd Cycleway (Sustrans Route 887).

The business offers a range of hardtail and full-suspension bikes for hire at competitive daily rates, alongside e-bike options for those seeking an assisted ride. A workshop on site provides bike repairs, servicing, and a bike wash facility. An on-site café (Corrwg Cwtch Café, upstairs and licensed) serves refreshments, and camping is available at the adjacent Glyncorrwg Mountain Bike Centre and Campsite.

Afan A Blast Ltd was incorporated in September 2017 and remains an active company as confirmed by Companies House, with accounts filed to September 2024 and a confirmation statement dated September 2025.
